title: 黄仁勋之后 英伟达如何延续AI芯片优势
speaker: Bloomberg

segments.en: There were lots of things that Jensen Wong spoke to and that conversation was with Emily Chang, the host of the circuit on Bloomberg originals and Emily's with us now. I mean he was talking
segments.zh: 黄仁勋谈了很多，那场对话是与彭博原创节目《The Circuit》主持人Emily Chang进行的，Emily现在也在我们这里。他当时在谈论

segments.en: about his daughter and his son and I think his son-in-law reflect on that part of the conversation.
segments.zh: 他的女儿和儿子，还有他的女婿，回顾一下那部分对话。

segments.en: It was about succession. Well, first of all, his daughter, his son and his son-in-law, I'll work it in video. Right. And so the question actually was talk about Madison Huang,
segments.zh: 是关于接班的问题。首先，他的女儿、儿子和女婿，我会在视频里提到。对。所以问题实际上是谈谈黄敏珊，

segments.en: his daughter, who there have been multiple reports that she could be his successor.
segments.zh: 他的女儿，有多篇报道称她可能成为他的接班人。

segments.en: She was with him every step of that trip. We went with him to four countries in four days and I think she was there. She was there. She was there. She was there. She was there. She was there.
segments.zh: 那次行程她全程跟随。我们跟着他四天去了四个国家，我想她也在。她在那儿。她在那儿。她在那儿。

segments.en: Every day she, you know, when we were waiting for him multiple times, she would have the caterers, bring out food and drinks for the press. Everyone was very excited about that.
segments.zh: 每天，你知道，当我们多次等待他时，她会安排餐饮人员为媒体带来食物和饮料。大家对此都很兴奋。

segments.en: But I think it goes to the point that there is no obvious successor to him inside the company to give and just how he ran the company so unconventionally and it sets up a really big dilemma.
segments.zh: 但我认为这说明公司内部没有明显的接班人，也说明他经营公司的方式多么非传统，这带来了一个很大的难题。

segments.en: We didn't play the sound bite there, but I reviewed that part of the interview where he basically said the company being set up that way, Jensen at the top and then 60 direct reports and the
segments.zh: 我们没有播放那段录音，但我回顾了采访的那部分，他基本上说公司这样设置，黄仁勋在顶层，然后有60个直接下属，以及

segments.en: tens of thousands underneath them. That's why it's been successful. Talk a bit about that.
segments.zh: 下面数万人。这就是它成功的原因。稍微谈谈这一点。
